name: A2A
summary: Agent2Agent (A2A) is an open protocol for agents built on different frameworks and by different vendors to discover each other, delegate tasks and exchange results. Agents publish an Agent Card and expose tasks over JSON-RPC, gRPC or HTTP+JSON, with streaming and push notifications. Created by Google, it is now governed under the Linux Foundation.
facts: Google, donated to the Linux Foundation
Python, JavaScript, Java, C#/.NET, Go, Rust
Complementary: MCP is agent-to-tool, A2A is agent-to-agent
goodFor: Agents from different vendors working together
Long-running delegated tasks with status updates
Exposing an agent as a service
watchOut: Still needs auth and trust decisions between organisations
Peers must agree on the protocol version (A2A-Version header)
